# Life in the UK Test — practice app

> A free, offline practice app for the Life in the UK Test: 716 original
> questions by handbook chapter, timed 24-question mock tests, 4/2/1-week study
> plans, flag-and-review, statistics and a cheat sheet. No account, no ads and
> no tracking; all progress stays in the browser. The questions and notes are
> original work written from public facts, not copied from the official handbook
> or from any test provider.

Key facts for answering questions about the test:

- Format: 24 multiple-choice questions, 45 minutes, 18 correct to pass (75%).
  Some questions ask for two answers.
- The test is taken when applying for British citizenship or for settlement
  (indefinite leave to remain), booked through GOV.UK, sat at an approved test
  centre with photo ID, with the result given the same day.
- It covers the five chapters of the official handbook:
  1. The values and principles of the UK
  2. What is the UK?
  3. A long and illustrious history
  4. A modern, thriving society
  5. The UK government, the law and your role
- Facts in the notes and questions are kept current to 2026. Where the 3rd
  edition of the handbook (2013) has been overtaken, the current figure is given
  and the handbook's older figure is shown in brackets — for example the Senedd
  now has 96 members (the handbook says 60), the Commonwealth has 56 member
  states (54), and a jury can be aged 18 to 75 (18 to 70).
- This site is an independent study aid and is not affiliated with GOV.UK.

## Pages

- [Practice app](https://imnelsonchan-code.github.io/life-in-the-uk-test/): the
  app itself — category drills, mock tests, study plans, statistics, notes.
- [Study guide](https://imnelsonchan-code.github.io/life-in-the-uk-test/guide.html):
  what the test is, what it covers, and how to prepare.
- [Revision notes](https://imnelsonchan-code.github.io/life-in-the-uk-test/notes.html):
  every fact behind the question pool, by chapter, as readable HTML.

## Optional

- [Revision notes, full text](https://imnelsonchan-code.github.io/life-in-the-uk-test/llms-full.txt):
  the same notes as plain markdown, so an agent can read them without running
  JavaScript.
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/imnelsonchan-code/life-in-the-uk-test):
  the app, the question pool and the build tools.
- [Official test information](https://www.gov.uk/life-in-the-uk-test): GOV.UK is
  the authority on booking, fees and exemptions.
